desk.headline: HEPS up 6.9% to 171.3c as revenue rises 11.9% to R105.9bn and financial services grow 35%; cautious outlook on weak consumers and port delays
results: Revenue rose 11.9% to R105.9bn (7.3% organic) and operating profit 7.4% to R11.9bn; HEPS rose 6.9% to 171.3c, or 9.7% excluding the cost of setting up the PlusB bank.
The clothing and general merchandise business grew revenue 9.9% to R75.3bn but operating profit only 2.7% to R8.6bn.
Financial services was the standout: revenue up 35.2% to R6.2bn and operating profit up 37.0% to R1.5bn; the informal market (Flash) platform lifted profit 21.6% to R1.0bn.
Furniture, appliances and electronics revenue rose 16.3% to R14.5bn, largely from acquisitions, with profit up 1.6%; Brazil (Avenida) sales rose 12.5% in constant currency.
Cash from operations rose 40.6% to R15.3bn and free cash flow to R4.8bn (R1.7bn); the dividend rose 9.3% to 57.9c, and net debt was 0.67x EBITDA.

guidance.summary: No numbers in the announcement. Pepkor expects trading in southern Africa to stay constrained, with living costs squeezing shoppers and port delays slowing stock arrivals; FY2027 plans include 200+ new stores, closing the Shop2Shop merger and launching PlusB.

points: COO Sean Cardinaal said trading since year-end has been softer than hoped, with Durban port problems putting some Christmas stock at risk.
CFO Riaan Hanekom guided to HEPS growth just under 10% in FY2027 excluding PlusB costs, and lower including them.
The PlusB bank is targeted for launch in mid-2027; management said Shoprite's banking plans do not change its strategy.
Credit was tightened after one-off write-offs; debtors' costs are expected to fall below 22% of the book in FY2027.
Ackermans like-for-like sales fell 1.5%; Shoe City is closed and Swagga and SPCC are being exited.

watch: Black Friday and festive trading given port delays and softer early FY2027 sales.
PlusB banking licence approval and launch costs against the R920m spend plan.
Closing of the Shop2Shop merger, targeted for the first half of 2027.
